title: 第284章 销赃第283章 第二缕道则
slug: 转世成女开局攻略气运之子
content_zh:
天澜城，某处隐秘的地下黑市。
方玉凝坐在随身携带的躺椅上，翘着二郎腿。
面前的摊上，堆满了各式各样的物品。
说是琳琅满目，都有些谦虚了。
这几日劫掠下来，方玉凝将这次所获中，那些看着上乘的功法、武技、丹药和奇珍异宝，都塞进了灵犀殿内。
分别存放于各个分殿当中。
至于剩下那些品相一般、或者她根本看不上眼的次品。
全都被拉到了这黑市的摊位上。
“走过路过别错过啊！”
方十三扯着嗓子，将真元混入其中，朗声吆喝道：
“青元宗精品灵兵，心法，全场一折起售！”
“只要十块下品元晶，你买不了吃亏，买不了上当！真正的物美价廉……”
这一日，在黑市上捡漏的散修武者们，一个个都疯了。
平日里，这些中等势力把持着修炼资源，
散修想弄本入门心法都得给人当牛做马。
今日是怎的了，竟开始向外吆喝售卖。
“这位姑娘，这《翼火掌》当真只要十块下品元晶？”
一个满脸刀疤的汉子，下意识的咽着唾沫。
方十三一巴掌拍在桌子上，一改往日淑女人设。
反倒是脾气暴躁的将宽长的衣袖撸到两侧，露出一截粉白的手臂，

神情激动道：
“我家公子发话了，为造福南境武道，
让大家人人都能有功法看，人人都有武道可以修，
说十块就是十块！”
话音刚落，围观的众人，便纷纷掏出元晶，
抢得头破血流。
“沈公子仗义啊！”
“沈公子高义，当真是我等的贵人！”
方玉凝听着摊外的动静，
折扇轻摇，嘴角微微上扬。
名声这东西，有时候就是这么容易赚。
可惜连一个气运等级高的个体都不存在。
以至于压根接收不到情绪值的反馈。
一旁的方十三在售卖了大半东西后，
正清点着最后几件灵宝，黑市的入口处，却突然传来一阵骚动。
方玉凝闻声而动，抬眸看去。
待看见是两个穿着苍云南府官服的男子，大步走了进来。
content_en:
Tianlan City, a secret underground black market somewhere.
Fang Yuning sat on the recliner she brought with her, crossing her legs.
The stall in front of him was filled with all kinds of items.
To say it is a dazzling array of things is a bit modest.
After looting in the past few days, Fang Yuning stuffed the seemingly superior martial arts, martial arts, elixirs and rare treasures into the Lingxi Palace.
They are stored in each branch hall.
As for the remaining inferior products that were of average quality or that she didn't like at all.
They were all dragged to this black market stall.
“Don’t miss it if you’re passing by!”
Fang Shisan raised his voice, mixed the real energy into it, and shouted loudly:
“Qingyuan Sect’s exquisite spiritual weapons and mental techniques are all available at a 10% discount!”
"You only need ten yuan of low-grade Yuanjing, and you won't suffer any loss or be cheated! It's truly high quality and low price..."
On this day, all the casual cultivators who were picking up missing items on the black market went crazy.
On weekdays, these middle-level forces control cultivation resources.
If a casual cultivator wants to learn this introductory mental method, he or she will have to act like a bull and a horse.
What happened today? They started shouting and selling.
"Girl, does this "Wing Fire Palm" really only cost ten low-grade Yuan Crystals?"
A man with a scarred face swallowed his saliva subconsciously.
Fang Shisan slapped his hand on the table, changing his usual ladylike appearance.
Instead, he grumpily rolled up his long and wide sleeves to both sides, revealing a section of pink and white arms.
He said with an excited expression:
"My young master has spoken. In order to benefit the southern martial arts,
Let everyone have access to the exercises and martial arts to practice.
If you say ten dollars, it means ten dollars! "
As soon as he finished speaking, everyone onlookers took out Yuan Jing one after another.
He was beaten to a bloody head.
"Young Master Shen is so righteous!"
"Young Master Shen is so righteous, you are truly the noble man we have been waiting for!"
Fang Yuning listened to the movement outside the stall,
The folding fan shook slightly, and the corners of his mouth raised slightly.
Reputation is so easy to earn sometimes.
It's a pity that there is not even an individual with a high level of luck.
So much so that no feedback of emotional value is received at all.
Fang Shisan on the side, after selling most of the things,
While counting the last few spiritual treasures, there was a sudden commotion at the entrance of the black market.
Fang Yuning moved when she heard the sound and looked up.
When he saw two men wearing Cang Yunnan Mansion official uniforms, they strode in.
